whenToUse: Trend cards that plot monthly or weekly figures as bars, areas or a line
Part to whole breakdowns such as traffic sources, task status or plan tiers as donut and pie slices
Score profiles across several axes, such as team skills or audit results, as radar or radial bars

whenNotToUse.when: A finished metric card with period tabs, KPI tiles and a range switcher built in
Headline numbers with trend badges and no plotted series
A whole overview page with summary tiles above a trend and a work list

agentNotes: Replace the sample `chartData` array, and give each series or slice name it uses a `chartConfig` entry with a label and color
Each example caps its `Card` at `max-w-md` or `max-w-xs`; drop the cap so the chart fills a grid cell
`ChartContainer` sizes itself by `aspect-video` unless a class overrides it, so set an aspect ratio or height class to fit a fixed tile
